hits.title: SEG Solar ramps up with a new 4 GW solar factory in Texas
hits.snippet: # SEG Solar ramps up with a new 4 GW solar factory in Texas SEG Solar is expanding its US manufacturing footprint again, this time with a new 4-gigawatt solar module factory planned for Houston, Texas. The company said today that the new facility will add nearly 500,000 square feet of manufacturing space and increase SEG’s total US solar module production capacity to around 6 GW annually. Commercial operations are expected to begin in Q3 2026. SEG says the Houston project represents more than $200 million in investment and will create up to 800 jobs. ... SEG’s first US factory was a 2 GW solar module plant. With the new Houston facility, the company says it expects to become one of the largest fully US-owned solar module manufacturers. ... SEG’s Houston announcement follows its previously announced plan to build a 5 GW ingot and wafer manufacturing facility in Indonesia. Construction on that facility is expected to start in Q2 2026. If completed, the Indonesia project would give SEG a more vertically integrated solar supply chain spanning ingots, wafers, cells, and modules.
